encoding: gzip little-endian float32 integrated bin energy, row-major
orientation: upright display x-right/y-down; optical inversion included; no centroid recentering
captureFractionDefinition: radiant W in +/-0.25 mm divided by radiant W in the 4x4 mm reference detector; photopic Y is normalized separately within the exported window
spectrum: D65 380-780 nm; photopic Y; dispersive FdC materials
diffraction: OPTrace HURB approximation, not full wave optics

vivity_inspired_v2_1_dc_v1.evidence: Frozen Monofocal Refraction Audit selected scalar; formal quadratic-sag wrapper; no new optimization.

provenance.allocation_assumption: delta sag = integral[r * measured departure / (1000*0.218)] dr on anterior only; exact surface prediction must be verified by OPTrace
provenance.absolute_power_note: NIMO absolute power/conjugate calibration not treated as exact thick-eye spectacle refraction. No mixing of Clareon numerical data into fit.

far_refraction_calibration.method: single bounded base-power scalar, maximize infinity MTF50 in 3mm-average Arizona; fixed retina/ACD
far_refraction_calibration.not_a_commercial_fit: Finite-pupil simulation calibration, not an adjustment to Schmid/Clareon data or a recovered DFT015 base curvature.

v2_1_refinement.correction: delta z_front = a4*r^4; analytic slope 4*a4*r^3, r/sag mm; unchanged paraxial curvature
v2_1_refinement.operator: 546nm; n_medium=1.336; isolated IOL; common exit plane z=.593mm; P=-1000*n*sin(theta)/r_exit
v2_1_refinement.selection: linear response from a4=0 and 1e-4, matched outer power slope only; optional one scalar correction; no Zernike/MTF fitting
v2_1_refinement.central_departure_note: radius_mm, departure_power_D, smoothing=.04 mm, taper, amplitude unchanged. Total central power can change because the base is corrected.
v2_1_refinement.offset_note: Original -0.37583134090270454 D retained; not refit to MTF.
v2_1_refinement.wavefront_convention_status: n,m and optical-zone diameter verified; export normalization/HOA sign/projection not fully specified; conditional W=-S, OSA unit RMS only.

vivity_inspired_v2_1_dc_v1.design_frozen: 2026-10-27; author-profile shape fixed, one bounded finite-pupil base-power calibration; no fitting to Schmid or Clareon ordinates
vivity_inspired_v2_1_dc_v1.nominal_power_note: 20 D is the baseline reference label. Added surface correction changes effective power; no new commercial nominal power is asserted.

distance_correction.surface_note: Quadratic addition retains the baseline higher-order sag; corrected spherical control is not an exact two-sphere lens.

eye.units: geometry mm; wavelength nm; optical power dioptres; SA reference micrometres
eye.pupil_definition: physical iris aperture diameter, not entrance pupil
eye.SA_caveat: Patent Table 2 conics transferred to Arizona anterior cornea only; quoted SA values belong to Alcon-Navarro model, not measured here. Patent describes RMS SA at 6-mm pupil for IOL; Table 2 does not independently state full corneal Zernike normalization/reference pupil. No claim of exact OSA Z4^0 values in this hybrid eye.
